what_it_does: Describes a digital phase-locked loop (DLL) for FMCW radar (frequency-modulated continuous-wave radar used in autonomous vehicles and IoT). The circuit generates chirps (frequency sweeps) from 11 to 16.4 GHz with a slope of 3.4 GHz per microsecond and 5.32 GHz total bandwidth. Uses digital predistortion (DPD)—a technique correcting circuit nonlinearity—that converges in just 5 chirp cycles and achieves 0.043% RMS frequency error. Designed for rapid frequency-hopping to handle multi-vehicle interference and multi-mode radar operation.
